mcq_drop.why: oddly worded ('first and last facts mentioned'); no exam phrases it this way

pyq_bad.why: garbled (Rajya Sabha seat numbers missing from options)

patterns: APPSC favours odd-one-out items: Kerala had no formal autonomy demand; Indrajit Gupta Committee is not on Centre-State relations.
Commission-recommendation matching recurs: Rajamannar (abolish AIS, delete Art. 356), Sarkaria (ISC, 356 sparingly, Governor an outsider), Punchhi (impeachment-like removal of Governor).
A-R format on AIS violating federal principle (APPSC G2 2025) and on Sarkaria/Art. 356.
Other PSCs ask which commission led to the ISC (Sarkaria) and SCS facts (Bihar never granted).
App MCQs cover the same ground but add current-affairs items (131st Amendment Bill, devolution debates) and longer multi-statement sets.
